chapters.title: Reversed root-right-to-left preorder
chapters.code:
def postorder(root):
    out, stack = [], [root] if root else []
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        out.append(node.val)
        stack.extend(node.children)      # last child popped first
    return out[::-1]
